content.comment_body: I had installed on my laptop with Windows 10 Pro [product_name] from [version_no] up to [version_no]. It functioned smoothly for a long period, but then random issues started occurring. Whenever I try to run any version of [product_name], the program flashes briefly and doesn't open at all. I attempted to roll back before any recent updates, updated Java, and tried other troubleshooting steps, even a thorough reinstallation of [product_name], but the issue persists. Interestingly, I have another laptop at home with a similar setup where [product_name] works flawlessly, and I update it regularly with no problems. Has anyone encountered this type of issue?

Do you have a folder, often called 'GodMode' with a name like 'GodMode.{ED7BA470-8E54-465E-825C-99712043E01C}' on your desktop? The part following the dot is crucial, while the first part can vary. This folder is no longer compatible with [product_name]. After removing it, [product_name] started working again for other users.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a sudden issue where [product_name] failed to start, flashing briefly before closing, which was isolated to a particular device. The problem was traced to the existence of a Windows 'GodMode' folder on the desktop, which conflicts with [product_name]. This reveals that certain Windows customizations can unexpectedly disrupt normal functionality, leading to user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want [product_name] to reliably start and expect to be informed about potential conflicts or environmental factors with their system setup that could prevent the software from launching successfully.
